## Personal Finance Tracking and Budget Analysis Project

Before entering SIT, I studied Accountancy and Finance at Temasek Polytechnic. As part of my learning experience, I worked on a project related to personal finance tracking and budget analysis.

The project focused on recording daily expenses, categorising spending such as food, transport, and entertainment, and analysing spending patterns over time. The goal was to improve financial awareness and support better budgeting decisions.

Through this project, I gained a better understanding of how financial data can be organised and analysed to support decision-making. This experience also helped prepare me for learning new digital and analytical tools at SIT.
